purpose: Non-executable LMDB value format for the bounded PCQM geometry sidecar v2. It replaces pickle entirely; historical v1 values are never accepted by this contract.

framing.prefix: magic followed by a big-endian unsigned 32-bit canonical-JSON header length
framing.binary_blocks: C-order raw native arrays, contiguous from offset zero after the header, with no gap, overlap, trailing byte, duplicate reference, or unreferenced block

logical_hash_rule: SHA-256 of the existing raw-free logical_projection: every ndarray projects to dtype, shape, C-order, and SHA-256 of its raw C bytes; offsets and wire layout do not affect record_content_sha256.

payload_index.invariant: The payload index, LMDB keys, and admitted membership rows are a one-to-one set; each index row binds a safe wire value to the existing logical record hash.

prohibited: legacy v1 payload fallback in builder, replay gate, or reference audit
